cohort: Patients with suspected immediate post-cesarean complications.
finding: Multidetector computed tomography (MDCT) is effective in detecting and confirming acute post-cesarean complications and can aid in guiding their management.
mod_finding: The study identified that common acute post-cesarean complications included bladder flap hematoma, uterine dehiscence, uterine rupture, ureteric injury, gossypiboma, and pelvic sepsis.
